instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: RapidCedar Purchase Exception reviews urgent purchase requests through operational, manager, procurement, budget, and final-decision inputs. Operations Requesters identify the required item or service and operational impact; Department Managers record urgency justifications; Procurement Reviewers record sourcing options and compliance exceptions; Budget Partners record funding and cost centers and return unfunded requests; and Procurement Controllers decide after the required inputs are present. Supplier-commitment timing is disputed, while waiver authority for missing sourcing options and the urgent-decision deadline remain undecided.

output.summary: RapidCedar Purchase Exception reviews urgent purchase requests using operational, manager, procurement, budget, and final-decision inputs. Operations Requesters provide purchase and impact details, Department Managers record urgency justifications, Procurement Reviewers record sourcing and compliance information, Budget Partners assess funding and return unfunded requests, and Procurement Controllers record decisions after required inputs are present. Supplier-commitment timing remains disputed, while waiver authority and the urgent-decision deadline are undecided.
output.primary_goal: Review urgent purchase requests using operational, sourcing, compliance, budget, and final-decision inputs.
key_capabilities: Submit urgent purchase requests with required-purchase and operational-impact information.
Record sourcing options and compliance exceptions.
Record funding availability and cost centers.
Record approved or declined decisions after required inputs are present.
unresolved_points: Whether a supplier commitment may be made before Procurement Controller approval.
Which role may grant a waiver when sourcing options are missing.
The maximum acceptable time for deciding an urgent purchase request.
